verses.text: These are the wise sayings of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.
They will help you gain wisdom and learn from correction. They will help you understand wise words.
They will teach you to live wisely and to do what is right, fair, and honest.
They give good sense to simple people, and knowledge and good judgment to young people.
Let wise people listen and learn even more. Let people with understanding get good advice.
Then they will understand wise sayings and stories, the words and riddles of wise people.
Respect for the LORD is where knowledge begins, but fools hate wisdom and correction.
My son, listen to your father's teaching. Do not turn away from your mother's instruction.
Their teaching will be like a beautiful crown on your head and a necklace around your neck.
My son, if sinners try to tempt you, do not give in to them.
They may say, "Come with us. Let's hide and wait to kill someone. Let's ambush some innocent person just for fun.
Let's swallow them alive, like the grave swallows people, whole, like those who go down into the pit.
We will get all kinds of valuable things. We will fill our houses with stolen goods.
Join us, and we will all share the money equally."
My son, do not go along with them. Stay far away from their paths.
Their feet run to do evil. They hurry to kill people.
It is useless to spread a net where a bird can see it,
but these people set a trap for themselves. They are waiting to take their own lives.
That is what happens to everyone who is greedy for money they did not earn. Their greed takes away their own lives.
Wisdom shouts out in the street. She raises her voice in the public squares.
She calls out on the noisy street corners. At the city gates she makes her speech:
"How long will you simple people love being simple? How long will mockers enjoy making fun of others, and fools hate knowledge?
Listen to my warning and turn back. I will pour out my thoughts to you. I will make my words known to you.
I called you, but you refused to listen. I reached out my hand, but no one paid attention.
You ignored all my advice and did not want my warnings.
So I will laugh when disaster comes to you. I will make fun of you when trouble strikes,
when trouble hits you like a storm, when disaster comes on you like a whirlwind, when distress and pain overwhelm you.
Then they will call to me, but I will not answer. They will look hard for me, but they will not find me,
because they hated knowledge and did not choose to respect the LORD.
They did not want my advice. They rejected all my warnings.
So they will eat the fruit of the way they lived. They will be filled with the results of their own plans.
Simple people turn away from wisdom, and it kills them. Fools are careless, and it destroys them.
But whoever listens to me will live in safety. They will be at ease, with no fear of harm."
